author.description: Only return posts written by this account, e.g. openai or @openai.
author.title: From account

conversationId.description: Only return posts in this conversation (the numeric id of the root post).
conversationId.title: Conversation ID

dateFrom.description: Only return tweets posted on or after this date. Leave empty for no lower bound.
dateFrom.title: Start date

dateTo.description: Only return tweets posted on or before this date (inclusive). Leave empty for no upper bound.
dateTo.title: End date

endDate.description: Deprecated — use 'End date' instead. Kept so existing saved inputs keep working. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
endDate.title: End date (legacy)

excludeReplies.description: Skip replies and keep only top-level posts.
excludeReplies.title: Exclude replies

excludeRetweets.description: Skip retweets/reposts and keep only original posts.
excludeRetweets.title: Exclude retweets (reposts)

excludeWords.description: Words or phrases to exclude from every search, compiled to -word / -"two words" tokens.
excludeWords.title: Exclude words

inReplyTo.description: Only return replies addressed to this account, e.g. elonmusk or @elonmusk.
inReplyTo.title: In reply to account

includeLanes.description: Which X search lanes to run: latest, media, media-product, links, replies. Leave empty for the default latest + media + links (replies is added automatically for jobs of 100+ rows). media-product asks for X's product=Media page directly and is opt-in.
includeLanes.title: Search lanes

keywords.description: Words, phrases, hashtags or full X search queries to monitor. Each keyword is searched separately, and every result row tells you which keyword found it (searchTerm).
keywords.title: Search keywords

language.description: Only return tweets written in this language. Leave the default to search all languages.
language.title: Language

matchMode.description: How to combine the words in each keyword: all = X's default AND, any = (word1 OR word2), exact = quoted phrase.
matchMode.title: Multi-word match mode

maxAgeDays.description: Never walk further back than this many days, even when catching up after a long gap.
maxAgeDays.title: Maximum age (days)

maxItems.description: Alias of Maximum tweets per keyword. The actor accepts either name.
maxItems.title: Max tweets per keyword

maxPasses.description: Cap the total number of X search passes (core lanes + time windows) per keyword. 0 means no explicit cap.
maxPasses.title: Maximum search passes

maxTweets.description: Stop after this many tweets for each keyword. This is a target, not a guarantee: guest X search returns ~20 posts per answered page, the Phase 6 probes measured 300 unique rows for a 300-row target, and 500/1,000 are unverified.
maxTweets.title: Maximum tweets per keyword

maxWindows.description: Cap the number of backwards time-window passes per keyword. 0 means no explicit cap (the wall-clock budget still applies).
maxWindows.title: Maximum time windows

mentioning.description: Only return posts that mention this account, e.g. apify or @apify.
mentioning.title: Mentioning account

monitorId.description: Namespace for the saved watermark. Use different ids to keep independent schedules for the same keyword. Defaults to 'default'. The legacy alias 'monitoringStateKey' is also accepted.
monitorId.title: Monitor ID

monitoringEnabled.description: Alias that enables onlyNew when onlyNew itself is not provided. Prefer the Only new posts field.
monitoringEnabled.title: Enable monitoring (alias)

onlyImages.description: Only return tweets that contain at least one image.
onlyImages.title: Tweets with images only

onlyNew.description: Return only posts newer than the previous run for this keyword. The actor stores a numeric tweet-id watermark plus an overlap window in the key-value store, so scheduled runs do not repeat old rows.
onlyNew.sectionDescription: Use these fields when the actor runs on a schedule and should return only fresh posts. X guest search has no since_id, so the actor compares 19-digit snowflake ids numerically and walks an overlap window.
onlyNew.title: Only new posts (monitoring)

onlyQuotes.sectionDescription: Optional operator-style filters. Operator queries use the X guest search only; the Bing News fallback cannot honour them.
onlyQuotes.title: Quote tweets only

onlyVerifiedUsers.description: Only return tweets from verified (blue check) accounts.
onlyVerifiedUsers.title: Verified accounts only

onlyVideos.description: Only return tweets that contain at least one video or GIF.
onlyVideos.title: Tweets with videos only

overlapMinutes.description: How far back before the previous run to search, so posts published during the last walk are not missed. Already-seen ids are still filtered out.
overlapMinutes.title: Overlap window (minutes)

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Use a proxy if you run large jobs or see frequent IP-based rate limits.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

searchType.description: Latest returns the newest posts first. Top is engagement-ranked output: X's logged-out search never serves the real Top timeline, so the actor collects Latest pages and sorts them by like count client-side.
searchType.title: Result order

sinceTime.description: Optional lower bound for a backfill run: ISO 8601 timestamp or Unix epoch seconds. Uses X's epoch since_time operator, not day-granular since:.
sinceTime.title: Since time (backfill)

sort.description: Alias of Result order. The actor accepts either name.
sort.title: Result order (alias)

startDate.description: Deprecated — use 'Start date' instead. Kept so existing saved inputs keep working. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
startDate.sectionDescription: Deprecated aliases kept for backwards compatibility. Prefer the fields above.
startDate.title: Start date (legacy)

untilTime.description: Optional upper bound for a backfill run: ISO 8601 timestamp or Unix epoch seconds. Uses X's epoch until_time operator.
untilTime.title: Until time (backfill)
